_comment: High/critical advisories in backend production dependencies accepted for now. Each entry needs a reason and a review-by date; the CI audit step fails once the date passes or when the advisory is no longer reported (so the entry is removed). See docs/security.md.

GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828.reason: DoS via trailing bytes after a compressed request body. Reachable: the API parses JSON with body-parser 2.x (through @nestjs/platform-express). Fix is a lockfile bump (npm audit fix, no breaking change); tracked as a follow-up dependency PR, not done here to keep this change free of app/runtime changes.

GHSA-q7qp-rjg7-q26m.reason: DoS via a pending async fileFilter. Not reachable: no route uses file uploads (no FileInterceptor/multer usage in backend/src); pulled in by @nestjs/platform-express. Cleared by the same lockfile bump.
